colorTheme.description: Colour keyword for the fill or outline colour

endDate.description: The start date to be displayed; can be passed in via $attributes as either as a DateTime object, Unix timestamp, or a string in YYYY-MM-DD format.

locale.description: The locale to be used for formatting the date.

shortName.description: The name of the component without any namespacing, prefixes, etc. Used for BEM block/element naming. Derived from the Blade filename if not explicitly set.

showDay.description: Whether to show the day of the week.

startDate.description: The start date to be displayed; can be passed in via $attributes as either as a DateTime object, Unix timestamp, or a string in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tagName.description: The HTML tag to use for this component

testId.description: Optionally add a data-testid attribute for automated tests
